_comment: An example mod that changes a fighter's form during a battle. Copy this folder into user-content/ to try it. docs/anotherworld/design-battle-transform.md describes battle_forms.
name: Battle Forms
author: OB64: Another World
description: Every Fighter strikes three times in a battle: a Slash as a Fighter, a Claw as a Werewolf, then Rotten Breath as a Tiamat from any row. It turns back into a Fighter when the next strike of the battle starts.
